name: Specification change (RFC)
about: Propose a change to spec/ or schema/

---

## Problem
What can't be done, or what goes wrong, under the current specification? Cite the section.

## Evidence
A reproduction, a document that fails or passes when it shouldn't, or a real process that can't be expressed.

## Proposal
The rule as you would write it, with MUST/SHOULD/MAY.

## Compatibility
Which existing documents, implementations or conformance results would change?

## Conformance
Which fixtures in `conformance/` would test it?

## Alternatives considered
